text:
alex_support: Customer ticket #4521 — customer reports tool calls suddenly routed to fallback tool and billing spike. They say Python SDK is sending bytes arg and backend (Go) rejects.

alex_support: Repro summary: Py client calls tool 'image_store.write' with args {"key":"img-123","data":b'\x89PNG...'} and we see request body include the "b'..." literal. Backend logs: "json: cannot unmarshal string into Go value of type []uint8" then router picks fallback. Customer hit high cost. Ticket: https://redwood.support/t/4521

sam_eng: Can you paste the exact request payload? v small snippet

alex_support: here's the captured payload from their app (sanitized):
```
{"tool":"image_store.write","args":{"key":"img-123","data":"b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n\x00\x00'"}}
```

maria_sdk: ugh ok. Py devs often send raw bytes -> str() which yields the b'...' repr. TS/Go expect base64 encoded strings for []byte. So backend json.Unmarshal tries to decode but fails on leading b'

joon_go: Confirmed from logs:
```
2026-03-11T15:02:12Z router ERROR json: cannot unmarshal string into Go value of type []uint8
2026-03-11T15:02:12Z router WARN fallback to text-generator for tool image_store.write
```

sam_eng: Is this happening only with Python SDK or also raw HTTP from customers? any repro script?

alex_support: Customer is using our python sdk v0.8.1, but they modified arg handling. I made a minimal raw HTTP repro to hosted API (no SDK) and it reproduces if body contains b' prefix. script:
```
import requests
payload={"tool":"image_store.write","args":{"key":"img-123","data":str(b'\x89PNG\r\n')}}
resp=requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall',json=payload,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer REDACT'})
print(resp.status_code,resp.text)
```

maria_sdk: Good repro. Fix options:
- Py SDK: ensure bytes args are base64.b64encode(...).decode('ascii') before JSON
- Server: be lenient and accept "b'..." by stripping leading b' and interpreting escape sequences (temp hotfix)

sam_eng: For immediate mitigation we can add a router-layer tolerant-unmarshal that detects ^b' and tries to unescape. Not ideal but buys time.

joon_go: We can add a tolerant branch in decodeBytes(v string) that if strings.HasPrefix(v, "b'") { strip and unescape } — will file PR to router. Also log customer id so we can nudge them.

maria_sdk: I'll open SDK issue and prepare v0.8.2 patch to auto-encode bytes params and add docs note. PR #1203

alex_support: Customer notified and accepted workaround. They asked for ETA on SDK patch.

maria_sdk: ETA 48h for patch + test. Temporary server-side hotfix deployed to canary. infra-bot: deploy canary-to-us-west finished :rocket:

infra-bot: canary rollout succeeded on us-west-2 (build 2026.3.11-220)

alex_support: thanks team. created internal incident INC-4521 for tracking. :thumbsup:
